summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes obfuscated payload via downloaded Bun
details: package.json declares preinstall='node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is obfuscator.io-style obfuscated and, when Bun is not present on PATH, downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to execute an adjacent 727KB single-line file math_init.js (obfuscated with shuffled string arrays, hex identifiers, and an array-shift decoder). math_init.js is not referenced by the package's public entry (dist/index.js), is not a declared dependency, and its only invocation path is the preinstall hook via the downloaded Bun binary. A React SQL-table admin component has no legitimate reason to fetch a second language runtime purely to execute a bundled obfuscated blob at install time; this pattern is designed to defeat Node-based static review of the code that actually runs on the developer's machine on npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
